top_signals.title: Britain bought fake C4 explosives for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Flagship UK procurement unit paid a part-time US police officer for tonnes of plastic explosives with no detectable RDX, the main ingredient in military C4
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia Market Whiplash Far From Over, Says RBC’s Wu Silverman
top_signals.summary: Amy Wu Silverman, head of derivatives strategy at RBC Capital Markets, sees the VIX as “still pretty inflated” following the surge in Nvidia shares with the return of Jensen Huang as CEO. She speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
